searchText: EIPs For Glamsterdam Denvet 5 regarding 7954, I think it can be merged. I spoke with teams in Svalbard and all seemed okay with the limit being raised further. CC <@&1070471163219824730> <@&652918665943056397> <@&836981603216654336> <@&688090867927482525> I'm not happy with the way this happened. It completely surpassed the acd process and it goes back to the "convenient and small, but hidden complexity" problem that we had with Pectra (Not saying I'm against including it) we can modify EIPs in devnets (we are even adding new ones late)? however, yeah, it seems that most people are fine with it. I think this is a good outcome so if the process does not allow it, I think it is a flaw with the process personally can we get ack on this for next ACDT? we'll have lots of time to add this assuming glam-devnet-5 inclusion or rather a quick anyone against it, if no one speaks up simple merge sure
